items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I didn't meet him up there or know of him up there.

ctx.x: Well, what about, say, Tony Almarico, was he up there for them? That period I'm trying to remember, or did you know him?
I guess he made trips up there, but I've only read this from later. I didn't meet him up there or know of him up there.
What about Fazzola? Did you know him?
